\section[\texorpdfstring{\gu{ઇમારત} (imārat)}{ઇમારત (imārat)}]{\gu{ઇમારત} (imārat) — a large building}

\label{lesson:GU-C301-imarat}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Gujarati for to set alight, then the Gujarati for to be scalded.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \gu{ઇમારત}}
\textbf{\gu{ઇમારત}} — \emph{imārat} — \textquotedblleft{}a large building\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\gu{ગઈકાલે} \gu{રાત્રે} \gu{શહેરની} \gu{એક} \gu{જૂની} \gu{ઇમારતમાં} \gu{આગ} \gu{લાગી}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{gaīkāle rātre śahernī ek jūnī imāratmā̃ āg lāgī.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
Last night a fire broke out in an old building in the city.
\end{quote}

A feminine noun.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\gu{ઇમારત}} (\emph{imārat}) is usually traced, through Persian, to Arabic \emph{ʿimāra}, \textquotedblleft{}building, construction\textquotedblright{}. It is a large building, where \textbf{\gu{મકાન}} is any building or house.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for telling what happened.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{imārat}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{imārat}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{gaīkāle rātre śahernī ek jūnī imāratmā̃ āg lāgī.} — Last night a fire broke out in an old building in the city.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Gujarati for to set alight, then the Gujarati for to be scalded, then say \emph{imārat} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \gu{ઇમારત} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}A large building\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[\texorpdfstring{\gu{સીડી} (sīḍī)}{સીડી (sīḍī)}]{\gu{સીડી} (sīḍī) — a ladder}

\label{lesson:GU-C301-sidi}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Gujarati for to be scalded, then the Gujarati for a large building.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \gu{સીડી}}
\textbf{\gu{સીડી}} — \emph{sīḍī} — \textquotedblleft{}a ladder\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\gu{લોકો} \gu{સીડીથી} \gu{નીચે} \gu{ઊતર્યા}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{loko sīḍīthī nīce ūtaryā.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
People climbed down by the ladder.
\end{quote}

A feminine noun.

\begin{cousinweb}
comes from \emph{*śrīḍhi}, a form CDIAL reconstructs, and CDIAL lists the Gujarati noun, \textquotedblleft{}a ladder\textquotedblright{} (CDIAL 12709). \textbf{\gu{દાદર}} is a building's staircase; a \textbf{\gu{સીડી}} is a ladder you can carry.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for telling what happened.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{sīḍī}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{sīḍī}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{loko sīḍīthī nīce ūtaryā.} — People climbed down by the ladder.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Gujarati for to be scalded, then the Gujarati for a large building, then say \emph{sīḍī} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \gu{સીડી} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}A ladder\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[\texorpdfstring{\gu{ગૂંગળાવું} (gū̃gḷāvũ)}{ગૂંગળાવું (gū̃gḷāvũ)}]{\gu{ગૂંગળાવું} (gū̃gḷāvũ) — to choke (for want of air)}

\label{lesson:GU-C301-guglavu}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Gujarati for a large building, then the Gujarati for a ladder.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \gu{ગૂંગળાવું}}
\textbf{\gu{ગૂંગળાવું}} — \emph{gū̃gḷāvũ} — \textquotedblleft{}to choke (for want of air)\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\gu{ધુમાડામાં} \gu{ઘણા} \gu{લોકો} \gu{ગૂંગળાઈ} \gu{ગયા}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{dhumāḍāmā̃ ghaṇā loko gū̃gḷāī gayā.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
Many people choked in the smoke.
\end{quote}

Past (he …): \gu{તે} \gu{માણસ} \gu{ગૂંગળાઈ} \gu{ગયો}, \emph{te māṇas gū̃gḷāī gayo}.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\gu{ગૂંગળાવું}} (\emph{gū̃gḷāvũ}) No dictionary we use records an older form, so its history is not settled. Smoke and a closed room make people \textbf{\gu{ગૂંગળાઈ} \gu{જવું}}: they cannot get their breath.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for telling what happened.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{gū̃gḷāvũ}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{gū̃gḷāvũ}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{dhumāḍāmā̃ ghaṇā loko gū̃gḷāī gayā.} — Many people choked in the smoke.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Gujarati for a large building, then the Gujarati for a ladder, then say \emph{gū̃gḷāvũ} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \gu{ગૂંગળાવું} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}To choke (for want of air)\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.

\section[\texorpdfstring{\gu{ફાટવું} (phāṭvũ)}{ફાટવું (phāṭvũ)}]{\gu{ફાટવું} (phāṭvũ) — to burst; to split}

\label{lesson:GU-C301-phatvu}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Gujarati for a ladder, then the Gujarati for to choke.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \gu{ફાટવું}}
\textbf{\gu{ફાટવું}} — \emph{phāṭvũ} — \textquotedblleft{}to burst; to split\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\gu{ગરમીથી} \gu{દીવાલ} \gu{ફાટી} \gu{ગઈ}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{garmīthī dīvāl phāṭī gaī.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
The heat split the wall.
\end{quote}

Past (it …): \gu{તે} \gu{કપડું} \gu{ફાટી} \gu{ગયું}, \emph{te kapḍũ phāṭī gayũ}.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\gu{ફાટવું}} (\emph{phāṭvũ}) belongs with Sanskrit \emph{sphāṭayati}, \textquotedblleft{}causes to split\textquotedblright{}, where CDIAL lists the Gujarati verb, \textquotedblleft{}to be split\textquotedblright{} (CDIAL 13825). Cloth tears and walls crack with it: \textbf{\gu{ફાટી} \gu{ગયું}}.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for telling what happened.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{phāṭvũ}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{phāṭvũ}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{garmīthī dīvāl phāṭī gaī.} — The heat split the wall.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Gujarati for a ladder, then the Gujarati for to choke, then say \emph{phāṭvũ} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \gu{ફાટવું} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}To burst; to split\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.

\section[\texorpdfstring{\gu{ધડાકો} (dhaḍāko)}{ધડાકો (dhaḍāko)}]{\gu{ધડાકો} (dhaḍāko) — a bang; a blast}

\label{lesson:GU-C301-dhadako}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Gujarati for to choke, then the Gujarati for to burst.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \gu{ધડાકો}}
\textbf{\gu{ધડાકો}} — \emph{dhaḍāko} — \textquotedblleft{}a bang; a blast\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\gu{અચાનક} \gu{મોટો} \gu{ધડાકો} \gu{થયો}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{acānak moṭo dhaḍāko thayo.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
Suddenly there was a loud bang.
\end{quote}

A masculine noun.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\gu{ધડાકો}} (\emph{dhaḍāko}) comes from \emph{*dhaḍ}, \textquotedblleft{}throb, beat\textquotedblright{}, a form CDIAL reconstructs, and CDIAL lists the Gujarati noun, glossed \textquotedblleft{}a quick push\textquotedblright{} (CDIAL 6711); the sense of a loud bang, the commonest one today, is not in that gloss. It happens with \textbf{\gu{થવું}}: \textbf{\gu{ધડાકો} \gu{થયો}}.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for telling what happened.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{dhaḍāko}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{dhaḍāko}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{acānak moṭo dhaḍāko thayo.} — Suddenly there was a loud bang.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Gujarati for to choke, then the Gujarati for to burst, then say \emph{dhaḍāko} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \gu{ધડાકો} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}A bang; a blast\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
